methodologyNotes: Published self-serve consumer pricing was collected from each carrier's own pricing page on the accessed date; where the official page returned a 403/429 or rendered prices behind JavaScript, the figures were corroborated against dedicated 2026 carrier-pricing review sources (WhistleOut, yournavi.com, Droid-Life). All prices are per-month single-line USD with the standard AutoPay discount applied where the carrier advertises that as the headline rate; multi-line and limited-time promotional/intro rates are noted in each plan's notes rather than as the headline figure. Minutes/calls/overage fields are null because every plan in this vertical includes unlimited talk and text; there are no quote-only tiers in self-serve consumer mobile, so no monthlyUsd values are null.
